info.text:
Stop asking AI to write the email. Tell it who the email is for.
https://ka-performancefl.com/ai-launch/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-01-5

"Write a follow up email" gets you a form letter. "Write a follow up to a bakery owner who asked about pricing and is nervous about cost" gets you something you would actually send. Give it the brief: who it is for, what they need, what they worry about. Then you decide what goes out.

Both example replies were written by an AI model, shown unedited and trimmed where marked. The bakery is a fictional example. We build this habit into every AI setup we do for clients: the 90-Day AI Launch.

The music is AI generated.
